question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM for the highlighted word.**

The __**negligent** __attitude of the cops was criticised.
solution:
The correct answer is '**attentive**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct answer is: **attentive**.
 
• Explanation:
 
 
• **Negligent** (लापरवाह) means failing to take proper care or showing a lack of attention or concern.
 
• **Antonym**: **Attentive** (सावधान) means paying close attention or being vigilant.
 
• **Reluctant** (अनिच्छुक) means unwilling or hesitant.
 
• **Amplify** (विस्तारित करना) means to increase the volume, strength, or extent of something.
 
• **Bored** (उबाऊ) means feeling uninterested or weary because of lack of interest. 
 
 
 
• In the context of the sentence, the negligent attitude of the cops implies that they were not paying proper attention or care to their duties, so the appropriate antonym would be "**attentive**," meaning they should have been alert and observant.
 
• *Sentence: The **attentive** attitude of the security guards ensured that no unauthorized persons entered the premises.*
